title: Irish Buckwheat Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting casserole made with wholesome buckwheat and a hint of Irish charm. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: In a large saucepan, sauté the buckwheat groats in the Irish butter until lightly toasted.
Add the wholesome vegetable broth and casserole seasoning. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the buckwheat mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with additional Irish butter if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
